name: Velka Ube-Cardamom Surge Chews
description: Dense, chewy synth-protein-forward stim candies designed for augmented users who need rapid-uptake energy during chrome-intensive activity; ube and cardamom flavoring masks the protein-compound base.
flavor_profile: Sweet purple ube with a warm cardamom spice finish; slightly gritty texture from the synth-protein matrix, with a slow-release energy tingle that starts at the back of the jaw
cultural_context: Common in Tier 2 labor pools where workers run basic chrome augments that increase metabolic demand; considered a working-class performance product rather than a luxury stim, and often bought in bulk rolls of ten.
story_hooks: A shipment of Velka Surge Chews is found to contain a compound that interferes with lower-tier chrome calibration — whether it's sabotage or a formulation error, augmented workers are going haywire.
A Tier 3 athlete is disqualified from a competitive event after testing positive for a stim compound in Velka Chews that wasn't listed on the label.
Velka's bulk discount program is being used as a front to distribute unlicensed bioactive compounds to chrome-heavy labor gangs on the Shelf.
